Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-c.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically. There are 6 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, please share your update. What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: Yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and nothing is blocking you.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock the summary page work by getting the idempotency keys in?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

I’ve noted your update.

Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline; I’ll add it to the parking lot. Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timing out and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker that the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review and your commitment to chase them today; blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Thanks, Maya. Admin, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
Mail blockers.
For the Mail blockers you mentioned, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.

Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll sync with her after the stand-up..

Admin, task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker that the sandbox was down and your commitment that you should finish it tomorrow; blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: the summary page work is on track and will resume after idempotency keys are in; bug 12 is blocking settlement validation due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway; PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review; mail blockers were mentioned; and the sandbox was down. A side discussion about gateway timeouts was parked for offline follow-up. Task 19 is flagged as stale and at risk, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
